name: @passport-evm/erc20-vault-contract
description: Project 00034 PR-F: a WITNESS-FREE fork of sig-net/midnight-examples examples/erc20-vault @ 11482cd, so a Passport account can reach the Signet ERC20 bridge by cross-contract call. Deposit and withdraw only; no Uniswap, no Aave, no callerSecretKey.
//compile: The callee is compiled BEFORE the caller: the compiler resolves the declared contract type `SignetSigner` to <compact-path>/SignetSigner and embeds a fingerprint of its verifier key. The singleton is recompiled from the VENDORED source rather than linked from @sig-net/midnight-contract/dist/managed (Sig Network's own recipe): every published version of that package pins compact-runtime 0.18.0-rc.1 and cannot be loaded on the 0.19.0 runtime this project uses. Question Q20; the verifier keys come out byte-identical, which tests/signet-vk-compare.test.ts re-checks.

scripts.compile:signet: COMPACT_PATH=node_modules compact compile +0.34.0 --feature-zkir-v3 --compact-path node_modules src/vendor/signet-contract.compact managed/SignetSigner
scripts.compile:vault: COMPACT_PATH=node_modules compact compile +0.34.0 --feature-zkir-v3 --compact-path node_modules:managed src/erc20-vault.compact managed/erc20-vault
scripts.compile: npm run compile:signet && npm run compile:signet-circuits && npm run compile:vault
scripts.witness-free: test "$(grep -c '^witness' src/erc20-vault.compact)" = "0" && echo 'witness-free: OK (0 witness declarations)'

//compile-signet-circuits: @sig-net/midnight's own `pureCircuits` export is a generated module pinned to compact-runtime 0.18.0-rc.1, so importing the package root throws on the 0.19.0 runtime. We recompile the very file the package ships (src/circuits.compact) and serve it through src/signet-sdk.ts. Question Q25; tests/signet-circuits.test.ts pins the rebuild against the package's own TypeScript twins.
